title: Low-access local health knowledge collaboration
purpose: Let local caregivers, translators, researchers and tool builders create a source-grounded local knowledge package across different AI access levels.
problem: A community has long-term care knowledge, but connectivity is unstable, hosted AI is restricted and most materials use local terminology.
differences: local expressions do not map cleanly to international terminology
raw personal data cannot leave the locality
understanding: Build a source, term and difference map before producing any generalized conclusion.
